concerns.text: SC‑005 requires a ±5 % entropy‑cutoff sweep evaluated over 5 random seeds and reporting the standard deviation (σ) of FID scores. Task T012 performs the sweep but runs each modified lookup table only once and does not incorporate multiple seeds nor compute σ, leaving the requirement unfulfilled.

Constitution principle VII mandates demonstrating a 15–20 % quantization‑error reduction for high‑entropy prompts. No task in tasks.md explicitly measures or validates this quantitative target, so the requirement is not covered.
